description.value:
This generator converts your movement into electrical energy, recharging an attached battery. The kinetic generator produces 1 charge per 10 minutes of movement; typical daily activities produce enough movement to charge the generator, but no charges are produced while you sleep or sit still. The kinetic generator can hold one battery at a time, and batteries can be attached or removed with a single Interact action.

Activate—Short Circuit r (electricity)

Trigger You're hit by a creature's melee attack

Requirements A battery with at least 10 charges is attached to the kinetic generator

Effect You consume all the attached battery's charges, dealing @Damage[4d6[electricity]] damage to the triggering creature (@Check[reflex|dc:23|basic] save).
